findings.description: The model id is sanitized to [A-Za-z0-9._:-] before the first yq lookup, but the alias target read back from the catalog (`target`, line 82) is stripped of its provider prefix and interpolated unsanitized into a second yq expression as `."$m"` (line 85). A catalog alias value containing a double quote or yq syntax changes the query. The default catalog is the System Zone file `.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml`, but `--catalog FILE` accepts any path, and yq expressions can call `load()`/`load_str()` on arbitrary files. Impact is bounded because the result is validated as `^[0-9]+$` before use, so this is defense-in-depth rather than an exploitable path.
findings.failure_mode: A crafted alias value in a user-supplied or tampered catalog alters the yq query; at worst it misclassifies the session or causes an opaque yq error that silently falls back to `long`.
findings.suggested_fix: Re-apply the same character whitelist to `m` after the alias substitution, e.g. `m="${m//[^A-Za-z0-9._:-]/}"` on line 83, or pass the key via `yq --arg`/`env()` instead of string interpolation.

findings.cross_file_justification: The hook's output drives the thresholds in `context_discipline.md`, which is included into ten SKILL.md files; those thresholds govern when tool results are synthesized to NOTES.md.
findings.description: The class defaults to `long` (thresholds 20K/50K/30K/150K, ten times the previous values) whenever the model cannot be resolved: no `.model` in the payload, jq or yq missing, an unknown model id, or a stdin read that times out. This is fail-open toward the most permissive setting. A ≤200K model running under an unrecognized id or a harness that omits `.model` inherits a 150K-token session budget before synthesis is required, which is close to its whole window and defeats the clearing protocol's purpose of preserving state before compaction.
findings.failure_mode: On a 200K-context model with an unresolvable id, the agent accumulates up to 150K tokens of tool results before extracting findings to NOTES.md; compaction or a context-limit error then discards unsynthesized state, which the lower `standard` thresholds were designed to prevent.
findings.suggested_fix: Either record `basis=default` with a visible warning line on SessionStart when the model could not be resolved, or make the unresolved case fall to `standard` unless the payload positively identifies a ≥1M model. At minimum, surface the fallback in `/loa` so operators know to set `LOA_CONTEXT_CLASS=standard`.
